dedupe_keys.name: bornes de comptage cyclistes et pietons chiffres

description: Bornes de comptage cyclistes et piétons - Chiffres is a dataset listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville de Liège. Ce jeu de données fournit les chiffres du comptage des cyclistes et des piétons par les bornes de comptage installées à Liège. Ces dispositifs, équipés d'un écran d'affichage en temps réel, mesurent à la fois le trafic des cyclistes et des piétons (mais seuls les premiers sont affichés sur les écrans). Coverage: Wallonia and Brussels. The portal files it under Mobility. Its keywords are mobilité douce, vélo, bikecount, mobilité, piéton, compteur. The portal shows 127,032 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2021-08-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
